`calendar_week.html` is a small synthetic fixture for focused parser tests.

`calendar_week_live.html` is an unmodified public calendar page fetched with CloudScraper from `https://www.crunchyroll.com/simulcastcalendar?filter=premium&date=2026-10-19` on 2026-10-21. The parser reads seven days and 40 releases from this snapshot. It contains no authenticated session cookies.
